notes: ReCut is maintained as ordinary source in an upstream-connected fork, pinned by vendor/paper-mario-recut.
The source commit preserves all 11,219 prepared Preview 2 files and modes. No game/runtime/renderer version upgrade.
Private ROM and generated game inputs remain outside the source graph. See docs/SOURCE_MAINTENANCE.md.

paperMarioReCut.provenance: Prepared Preview 2 source, unchanged upstream base; see docs/source-maintenance/patch-map.json

mupen64plusRspHle.provenance: Pinned HLE NAUDIO backend used by the Paper Mario runtime

sdl2.provenance: SDL 2.32.10 source for native macOS and Apple mobile builds

zstd.provenance: zstd 1.5.6 source; supplies the upstream CMake files omitted from the flattened ReCut vendor tree

decomp.notes: Host GNU cpp required by the decomp configure step (macOS ships only clang cpp).
